name: ICON NARVAL storm-resolving simulations (NARVALI and NARVALII)
resolution: 2.5 km horizontal, 75 vertical layers, hourly output
access: Primary data used in this work is archived by the Max Planck Institute for Meteorology (contact: marco.giorgetta@mpimet.mpg.de).

scales.note: Limited-area storm-resolving ICON simulations covering 10S-20N, 68W-15E over ~2 months (1721 hourly output steps) across 75 vertical levels.
